shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Whisper-soft diffused shadow for floating elements.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The canonical 'Commit' or 'Confirm' action for inventory movements.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #116479 0%, #135e6d 100%); color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; transition: all 140ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f7f9ff, 0 0 0 4px #135e6d; }

components.name: Inventory Card
components.description: The base container for inventory items and stock details.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-col; gap: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0 24px 0 rgba(24, 28, 32, 0.04); } .ds-card-header { font-weight: 600; color: #116479; } .ds-card-body { color: #181c20; }

narrative.overview: LogiRest's visual identity is rooted in the philosophy of Operational Elegance. It captures the meticulous precision of a world-class Michelin-star kitchen—where every tool has its place, and every movement is intentional.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal Depth: Boundaries established through background shifts, not borders.
RTL-First Integrity: Optimized for Arabic eye-flow.
Authoritative Density: High visible data without cognitive overload.

rules.name: The No-Line Rule
rules.body: 1px solid borders are strictly prohibited for sectioning. Boundaries are established exclusively through background color shifts.

rules.name: The Flush Surface Rule
rules.body: Components do not 'float' with heavy shadows. They are 'inset' or 'overlaid' through background contrast.

dos: Do use tonal backgrounds to separate functional groups.
Do anchor the visual weight at the top right for RTL eye-flow.
Do prioritize IBM Plex Sans Arabic for all high-density data.
donts: Don't use 1px solid borders for sectioning.
Don't use neon gradients or heavy drop shadows.
Don't use decorative animations that delay data visibility.
